description: Verified earlier versions (vintages) of canonical minute files, data/<SYMBOL>/data.csv. The files only grow by appending rows after their last bar (npm run datasets -- append), so each vintage is exactly the first `bytes` bytes of today's file and hashes to `sha256`: a study's whole-file pin of an earlier file is that vintage's sha256, and its input is recovered and verified as that prefix (src/lib/canonicalPrefix.ts verifyBytePin; npm run datasets -- prefix). Oldest first. `datasets append` adds the new vintage of every symbol it appends; src/data-partition/tests verify every entry against the local files when they are present. Market data never enter Git: only these facts do.
